title: Public API specification
deliverable: Stabilize pre-1.0 JSON envelopes, binary artifact routes, pagination, errors and capability negotiation.
acceptance: Local and HTTP transports pass shared use-case tests; framework request types never enter the application layer.

title: Job lifecycle API
deliverable: Add queued/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled/expired states, progress events and resumable observation.
acceptance: Reconnection and duplicated requests cannot create ambiguous terminal states or leak another principal’s job.

title: Artifact transfer API
deliverable: Add bounded uploads, integrity checks, range downloads, retention and explicit remote-consent UX.
acceptance: Incomplete uploads remain staged; large files do not travel as JSON Base64 payloads by default.

title: Repository contracts
deliverable: Define atomic recipe revision saves, job leases, permissions, metadata search and transaction boundaries.
acceptance: Contracts describe domain semantics instead of generic execute-SQL methods; an in-memory adapter passes the suite.

title: PostgreSQL adapter
deliverable: Implement parameterized queries, pool configuration and migrations outside core domain packages.
acceptance: Recipes and jobs pass repository tests on an actual PostgreSQL instance; driver row types stay in the adapter.

title: Database TLS seam
deliverable: Wire tokio-postgres through a replaceable TLS connector and explicit identity/trust configuration.
acceptance: Certificate validation failures are fatal; a mock provider proves database TLS is not permanently tied to rustls.

title: OpenBao SDK admission
deliverable: Admit the latest stable openbao SDK into a dedicated std adapter with minimal reviewed features and server compatibility checks; keep it outside portable defaults.
acceptance: Use the real TLS OpenBao fixture and compatibility policy; token and error diagnostics are redacted; no SDK transport types reach application APIs.

title: Application secret references
deliverable: Connect service configuration and SecretRef resolution to scoped AppRole with leased credentials; exclude recipe-operation keys from default persistence.
acceptance: Missing, expired and revoked credentials fail closed; no root token or recovery key is delivered to API/worker processes; cross-workspace secret requests fail.

title: Secret rotation lifecycle
deliverable: Implement token renewal, AppRole re-provisioning, credential rotation and restart convergence behind secret-store contracts.
acceptance: Expiry, rotation during work, OpenBao outage and audit failure are exercised; old grants cannot be reused and no static secret fallback appears.

title: OpenBao database leases
deliverable: Evaluate and qualify the current PostgreSQL database plugin; separate migration and runtime identities and map lease revocation to pool behavior.
acceptance: Real leased login/expiry/revocation fixtures pass; stale pooled credentials are discarded; unsupported beta/plugin compatibility gets a new owned pass.

title: Identity and sessions
deliverable: Add server authentication, bounded sessions, token expiry, CSRF defenses and optional identity-provider integration.
acceptance: Authorization is enforced server-side for every object; browser-local use remains anonymous and database-free.

title: Workspace authorization
deliverable: Add owner/editor/viewer roles, tenant scoping and explicit service-account permissions.
acceptance: Cross-workspace and confused-deputy tests fail closed even without database-specific row-security features.

title: Isolated execution workers
deliverable: Move remotely submitted CPU work into restricted processes with memory, CPU, disk and egress policies.
acceptance: A parser crash or non-cooperative job can be killed without taking down API or other tenants.

title: Admission and quotas
deliverable: Add principal/workspace job quotas, maximum artifacts, rate limits and queue backpressure.
acceptance: Repeated tiny requests and large expanding jobs cannot bypass aggregate resource accounting.

title: Valkey application adapter
deliverable: Implement bounded optional metadata/cache access behind application-owned CacheStore with scoped keys and revision-aware identities.
acceptance: Cache miss, outage, poison, stale revision and cross-tenant probes pass against Valkey; authoritative data and permissions survive without cache.

title: Valkey invalidation and outage
deliverable: Prove TTL, revocation invalidation, resource ceilings and eviction behavior without giving cache authority over authorization.
acceptance: Revoked grants are checked against authoritative state; connection failures do not bypass quotas; cache poisoning and invalidation races have regressions.

title: Durable jobs and leases
deliverable: Add job leases, fencing tokens, worker heartbeat, retry eligibility and idempotency records.
acceptance: Expired workers cannot finalize duplicate results; retry is prohibited for unsafe external side effects.

title: Server networking policy
deliverable: Centralize outbound connections, redirects, destination restrictions, credentials and HTTP limits.
acceptance: SSRF, rebinding, private/metadata destinations and mapped-address cases are covered before user HTTP operations are public.

title: Metadata-only observability
deliverable: Add health, readiness, redacted audit events, bounded metrics and structured operational errors.
acceptance: Default logs contain no raw inputs, outputs, secrets or high-cardinality user payload labels.

title: Server deployment profile
deliverable: Ship a hardened single-node deployment with reverse-proxy and direct-TLS options, backups and cleanup jobs.
acceptance: Restart and restore drills preserve metadata/artifact consistency; insecure development defaults cannot silently become public.

title: Service TLS deployment policy
deliverable: Qualify native PostgreSQL/Valkey/OpenBao TLS, certificate identity, trust roots and private service networks independently of local fixture shortcuts.
acceptance: Wrong names, unknown roots, expired certificates, missing TLS and unauthorized service clients fail; deployment never publishes administrative endpoints.

title: OpenBao production recovery custody
deliverable: Separate production recovery shares, initial bootstrap identity and app credentials; automate operational configuration and rehearse restore and rotation.
acceptance: Independent custody/recovery, audit-disk failure, snapshot restore and expired bootstrap identity are tested; one-share local test material is rejected in production.

title: PostgreSQL beta-to-GA upgrade drill
deliverable: When available admit PostgreSQL 19 GA after upstream review; rehearse dump/restore or documented upgrade from the beta baseline.
acceptance: Restore and repository/authorization fixtures pass on pinned GA; no beta data directory is reused blindly; rollback is executable and 1.0 uses GA.

title: Server security gate
deliverable: Test authentication, object authorization, uploads, worker isolation, cancellation and resource abuse.
acceptance: Public remote execution stays disabled until isolation and quota tests pass; local web mode remains independently releasable.
